svg.title: noirvpn server architecture
svg.desc: Clients connect over raw UDP, raw TCP, TLS or WebSocket inside TLS to the listeners of the noirvpn daemon. The daemon runs the control channel and, by default, the data path and the tun device. It publishes events and takes requests on the local control bus. With datapath udco, an optional userspace DCO service takes over the data path over a Unix socket.
